items.title: Embedded
items.description: We act as part of your team, not a vendor you brief once a quarter. We join your calls, learn your priorities, and own the work. When priorities change, we change with you.

items.title: Straight talk
items.description: You get plain answers and clear reporting. We tell you what is working, what is not, and what we would do next. No jargon. No padding.

items.title: Built for small business
items.description: We know small teams have limited time and budget. We keep the scope tight and the plan simple. We spend where it moves the numbers.

items.question: Who is PrimeDesk for?
items.answer: Any small business that wants a full marketing team without hiring one.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: Houston, Texas. Our team spans four countries, so work moves across time zones.

items.question: Can I hire you for one service?
items.answer: Yes. You can take the full program or a single service.

items.question: How much of my time does this take?
items.answer: The first three months need the most input while we learn your business. We keep your ongoing involvement focused on direction, reviews, and feedback.

items.question: How do you tailor the work to my business?
items.answer: We learn your priorities and how your team works, then tailor the engagement around that. We aim to start from day one and adjust as your priorities change.

items.question: What does PrimeDesk take on?
items.answer: We handle research, strategy, execution, content, and upkeep of your marketing assets.

items.question: How long is the contract?
items.answer: Our contracts are designed for a minimum of 12 months.
